title: Query budget and reconstruction evidence stay consistent and reproducible

invariants.description: No target may use more than its 1-query budget (observed 200/200 queries = 100% utilisation).
With one query per target, most targets must stay unresolved (observed 138/200 = 69.0%), so the budget visibly limits the attack.
Abstentions are never counted as correct: accuracy comes from eliminations only (observed 62/200 = 31.0%), not from the 69% the prior would have guessed.
Both records must pass integrity + lineage verification (every decision re-derived from its stored queries) and the attack must replay bit-identically.
The adaptive attack against label-only output keeps the same 1-query budget.

rationale: Budget accounting, abstention semantics and the stored reconstruction evidence must agree and reproduce exactly; this is what makes the other ML03 numbers checkable.
